production_cache.role: Last shipped generation. Do not write new extractions here.

archive.policy: Read-only. Do not recreate these directory names at the dataset root.

shadow_cache.name: ai_cache_v4_shadow
shadow_cache.policy: Empty directory for the next extraction generation. Push scripts are not pointed here.

docling_chunks.note: The other 90 allowlisted startups are ingested from raw/ on their first v2 extraction.

canonical_scripts.note: /data/scraping/scripts/ also holds unrelated non-CTO jobs. Only the files listed here are part of this lock.
canonical_scripts.v1_extractor: Exits unless CTO_ALLOW_V1_EXTRACTOR=1. An opted-in rerun writes to ai_cache_v1_hold, not ai_cache_v3_strict and not a recreated ai_cache_clean.
canonical_scripts.push_scripts: Unchanged. scripts/13_push_clean_extractions_to_supabase.py still commits to startup_extractions and defaults to data/ai_cache_v3_strict. scripts/15_push_v2_extractions_to_supabase.py still requires --commit and defaults to data/ai_cache_v2. Neither is pointed at ai_cache_v4_shadow.

phase2_routing.context: Primary documents are placed first inside a 300000 character cap. A category with no classified primary file is scored null at confidence 0 and the model is not called.
phase2_routing.classifier: Deliverable-name aliases outrank module numbers. Bare Canvas, Team, Legal, and Patent tokens are not classifiers. EBD9 is not folded into the executive summary. A generic filename is classified from the opening template title.
phase2_routing.text_verified: tests/test_cohort_doc_mapping.py reads all 92 allowlisted companies in data/parsed_clean (1465 PDFs). A template title in the opening must land in the same interface group as the resolved type.

phase3_clean_tree.gate: scripts/verify_data_integrity.py defaults to parsed_clean_v4 and exits 1 on failure. It passed there and fails on parsed_clean.
phase3_clean_tree.downstream: Grounding defaults to ai_cache_v4_shadow plus parsed_clean_v4 and refuses ai_cache_v3_strict. The verifier reads parsed_clean_v4. New Docling chunks go to docling_clean_v4, not the two stale companies in docling_clean. Push scripts are unchanged.
phase3_clean_tree.tensor_planet_financials: Embedded PDF text was written into parsed/ because the prior markdown was 22 bytes. The raw PDF was not deleted.
phase3_clean_tree.raster_pdfs: 33 image-only PDFs already had markdown. No second OCR pass was required.
